title: ASCII Post-Processing Rendering
prompt:
Use Three.js and AsciiEffect to display a 3D scene as ASCII art.

[Three.js Import Method (Must Be Followed Strictly)]
Use the following importmap in <head>, and import via ES Modules in <script type="module">:
<script type="importmap">
{ "imports": {
    "three": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js",
    "three/addons/": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/examples/jsm/"
} }
</script>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { AsciiEffect } from 'three/addons/effects/AsciiEffect.js';
</script>

[Scene Objects]
(1) The main object can be switched among TorusKnot, Sphere, and Box, and must continuously rotate slowly.
(2) Use AsciiEffect to wrap renderer/domElement and convert the rendered output into a character grid.

[Controls]
(3) Character set dropdown id="charset": values must include at least standard, extended, and minimal (the character table or resolution mapping passed to AsciiEffect may follow the implementation's conventions).
(4) Resolution slider id="resolution": controls the ASCII grid density (for example, through effect.setSize or an internal cell size; whether a larger or smaller value increases density must be consistent with the implementation and explained in the UI).
(5) Invert toggle id="invertToggle" (checkbox): inverts light and dark.
(6) Color toggle id="colorToggle": switches between colored and monochrome ASCII.
(7) Object dropdown id="objectSelect": value must be torusKnot | sphere | cube (consistent with __3D_STATE__.objectType).

[Default Values]
The recommended defaults are inverted=false and colored=true, to remain consistent with typical interaction tests.

[State Exposure (Required)]
Update window.__3D_STATE__ every frame:
  - charset: string ('standard'|'extended'|'minimal')
  - resolution: number
  - inverted: boolean
  - colored: boolean
  - objectType: string ('torusKnot'|'sphere'|'cube')
  - fps: number (finite positive number)

Output a single HTML file that runs when opened directly in a browser.
